html:
Wenceslas was duke of Bohemia from about 921 to 935, a Christian ruler of the Přemyslid family who was murdered by his brother Boleslaus and became the patron saint of the Czech lands.

He was raised a Christian by his grandmother Ludmila, herself murdered in a court feud and made a saint. As duke he supported the church and accepted the overlordship of the German king Henry the Fowler. On 28 September 935, or perhaps 929, he was killed at the door of a church in Stará Boleslav by his brother's men. His cult grew fast. Czech kings ruled under his crown, and Prague's main square bears his name, where the Velvet Revolution crowds gathered in 1989. In English he is Good King Wenceslas of a Victorian Christmas carol. He was buried in Prague, in the church that became St Vitus Cathedral.
sum: Wenceslas was duke of Bohemia from about 921 to 935, a Christian ruler of the Přemyslid family who was murdered by his brother Boleslaus and became the patron saint of the Czech lands.
